records.literal_gloss: In [the] year thirty and six of [the] reign of Asa went up Baasha king of Israel against Judah, and he built the Ramah, to not allow [one] going out and coming in to Asa king of Judah.

en.L: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and he built Ramah, so as not to allow [anyone] going out or coming in to Asa king of Judah.
en.B: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah, to keep anyone from going out or coming in to Asa king of Judah.
en.R: It was the thirty-sixth year of Asa's reign. Baasha king of Israel marched against Judah and built up the town of Ramah into a fortress. He wanted to stop anyone from traveling to or from the land of Asa king of Judah.

es.L: En el año treinta y seis del reinado de Asá subió Baasa rey de Israel contra Judá, y edificó Ramá, para no dejar a [nadie] salir ni entrar a Asá rey de Judá.
es.B: En el año treinta y seis del reinado de Asá, Baasa rey de Israel subió contra Judá y fortificó Ramá, para impedir que nadie saliera o entrara adonde estaba Asá rey de Judá.
es.R: Era el año treinta y seis del reinado de Asá. Baasa rey de Israel marchó contra Judá e hizo de la ciudad de Ramá una fortaleza. Quería impedir que alguien viajara hacia el país de Asá rey de Judá o saliera de él.

fr.L: En la trente-sixième année du règne d’Asa, Baésha, roi d’Israël, monta contre Juda, et il bâtit Rama, pour ne laisser [personne] sortir ni entrer chez Asa, roi de Juda.
fr.B: La trente-sixième année du règne d’Asa, Baésha, roi d’Israël, monta contre Juda et fortifia Rama, pour empêcher quiconque de sortir du royaume d’Asa, roi de Juda, ou d’y entrer.
fr.R: C’était la trente-sixième année du règne d’Asa. Baésha, le roi d’Israël, a attaqué Juda. Il a fait de la ville de Rama une forteresse. Il voulait empêcher les gens d’entrer dans le pays d’Asa, roi de Juda, ou d’en sortir.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na sita wa kutawala kwake Asa, Baasha mfalme wa Israeli akapanda dhidi ya Yuda, akaijenga Rama, ili asimruhusu [mtu yeyote] kutoka wala kuingia kwa Asa mfalme wa Yuda.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na sita wa utawala wa Asa, Baasha mfalme wa Israeli alipanda kuishambulia Yuda, akaiimarisha Rama, ili mtu yeyote asiweze kutoka wala kuingia kwa Asa mfalme wa Yuda.
sw.R: Ulikuwa mwaka wa thelathini na sita wa utawala wa Asa. Baasha mfalme wa Israeli aliishambulia Yuda, akaujenga mji wa Rama kuwa ngome. Alitaka kumzuia mtu yeyote asisafiri kwenda wala kutoka katika nchi ya Asa mfalme wa Yuda.

vi.L: Vào năm thứ ba mươi sáu triều A-sa, Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi lên đánh Giu-đa và xây Ra-ma, để không cho [ai] ra vào với A-sa vua Giu-đa.
vi.B: Năm thứ ba mươi sáu triều đại A-sa, Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi lên đánh Giu-đa và củng cố Ra-ma, để ngăn không cho ai ra vào với A-sa vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: Năm thứ ba mươi sáu A-sa làm vua, Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tiến đánh Giu-đa và xây thành Ra-ma thành một đồn lũy. Vua muốn ngăn không cho ai đi lại ra vào xứ của A-sa vua Giu-đa.

ko.L: 아사의 통치 제36년에 이스라엘 왕 바아사가 유다를 치러 올라와서, 라마를 건축하여 유다 왕 아사에게 [아무도] 나가거나 들어가지 못하게 했다.
ko.B: 아사가 다스린 지 36년째 되는 해에 이스라엘 왕 바아사가 유다를 치러 올라와서 라마를 요새로 만들었다. 유다 왕 아사에게 아무도 드나들지 못하게 하려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 아사가 왕이 된 지 36년째 되는 해였다. 이스라엘 왕 바아사가 유다를 치러 올라왔다. 그리고 라마라는 성읍을 튼튼한 요새로 만들었다. 유다 왕 아사의 땅으로 아무도 오가지 못하게 하려는 것이었다.

decisions.choice: parallel to 1 Kings 15:17, with a date added
decisions.reason: Verses 1-6 retell 1 Kings 15:17-22. The account of Baasha's move against Judah is the same word for word, except that Chronicles dates it to Asa's thirty-sixth year, where Kings gives no date.

decisions.choice: the thirty-sixth year of Asa's reign: the number as written, its reckoning uncertain
alternatives: the thirty-sixth year from the division of the kingdom (Asa's sixteenth year)
a copying error for the sixteenth or twenty-sixth year
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 16:8 says Baasha died in Asa's twenty-sixth year, so he cannot have attacked Judah in Asa's thirty-sixth. The figure here and the thirty-fifth year in 15:19 may count from the division of the kingdom under Rehoboam, about twenty years earlier, since the word for "reign" can also mean "kingdom"; that would place the attack in Asa's sixteenth year. Or a number may have been miscopied at some stage, perhaps sixteen or twenty-six read as thirty-six. The text is kept as written.

decisions.choice: built: fortified
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:17: Ramah was already a town, and Baasha built it up as a fortress. The same verb is used for Asa's work at Geba and Mizpah (verse 6).

decisions.choice: going out and coming in: all traffic to and from Asa's kingdom
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:17. Ramah, a town of Benjamin about five miles north of Jerusalem, sat on the main road, so a fortress there could close it. The traffic stopped may include people from the north who were going over to Asa (15:9).

decisions.choice: fortified (Balanced); built up ... into a fortress (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:17: Balanced and Readable say what the building was for (m3); Literal keeps "built".

decisions.choice: traveling to or from the land of Asa
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:17, Readable explains the idiom (m4) and makes clear that it means Asa's kingdom.

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 15:17-22 kept
decisions.reason: Verses 1-6 retell 1 Kings 15:17-22 (meaning decision); the Spanish Kings wording is kept at each level, with the date Chronicles adds.

decisions.choice: the French Kings wording reused for verses 1-6
decisions.reason: Verses 1-6 retell 1 Kings 15:17-22 almost word for word (m1), so every level keeps the French of 1 Kings 15 and changes only where the Hebrew of Chronicles differs.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 15:17-24 through the chapter
decisions.reason: Verses 1-6 and 11-14 retell 1 Kings 15:17-24 (m1 of each verse); the Vietnamese of Kings is kept at each level, changing only what Chronicles changes. Asa and Ben-hadad speak as allied kings, "tôi" and "vua".

decisions.choice: The wording of 1 Kings 15:17-24 at each level, changed where Chronicles changes the Hebrew; the date "제36년" (L), "36년째 되는 해" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Verses 1-6 and 11-14 retell 1 Kings 15:17-24; the Korean repeats Kings and adds the date Chronicles gives (m1).

source.text: וַיֹּצֵ֨א אָסָ֜א כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב מֵאֹֽצְר֛וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל־בֶּן־הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַיּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּדַרְמֶ֖שֶׂק לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought out Asa silver and gold from [the] treasuries of [the] house of Yahweh and [the] house of the king, and he sent to Ben-hadad king of Aram, the [one] dwelling in Damascus, saying,

en.L: And Asa brought out silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and of the house of the king, and he sent [it] to Ben-hadad king of Aram, who lived in Damascus, saying,
en.B: Then Asa brought out silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and of the king's palace, and sent it to Ben-hadad king of Aram, who ruled in Damascus, with this message:
en.R: So Asa took silver and gold out of the treasure rooms of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and of the royal palace. He sent it to Ben-hadad, king of Aram, who ruled from Damascus. Asa sent him this message:

es.L: Y sacó Asá plata y oro de los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y de la casa del rey, y [lo] envió a Ben-adad rey de Aram, que habitaba en Damasco, diciendo:
es.B: Entonces Asá sacó plata y oro de los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y del palacio real, y se lo envió a Ben-adad rey de Aram, que reinaba en Damasco, con este mensaje:
es.R: Así que Asá sacó plata y oro de las salas del tesoro del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y del palacio real. Se lo envió a Ben-adad, rey de Aram, que gobernaba desde Damasco. Asá le envió este mensaje:

fr.L: Et Asa fit sortir de l’argent et de l’or des trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et de la maison du roi, et il [l’]envoya à Ben-Hadad, roi d’Aram, qui habitait à Damas, en disant :
fr.B: Asa sortit alors de l’argent et de l’or des trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et du palais royal, et il les envoya à Ben-Hadad, roi d’Aram, qui régnait à Damas, avec ce message :
fr.R: Asa a donc pris de l’argent et de l’or dans les salles du trésor du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et du palais royal. Il les a envoyés à Ben-Hadad, roi d’Aram, qui régnait à Damas. Asa lui a fait dire :

sw.L: Asa akatoa fedha na dhahabu katika hazina za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na za nyumba ya mfalme, akazipeleka kwa Ben-hadadi mfalme wa Aramu, aliyekaa Dameski, akisema,
sw.B: Ndipo Asa akatoa fedha na dhahabu katika hazina za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na za ikulu ya mfalme, akampelekea Ben-hadadi mfalme wa Aramu, aliyetawala huko Dameski, na ujumbe huu:
sw.R: Basi Asa akatoa fedha na dhahabu katika vyumba vya hazina vya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na vya ikulu ya mfalme. Akampelekea Ben-hadadi, mfalme wa Aramu, aliyetawala kutoka Dameski. Asa akampelekea ujumbe huu:

vi.L: A-sa lấy bạc và vàng ra khỏi các kho của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và của nhà vua, rồi gửi [đến] Bên-Ha-đát vua A-ram, là người ở tại Đa-mách, mà nói rằng:
vi.B: Bấy giờ A-sa lấy bạc và vàng ra khỏi các kho của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và của cung vua, rồi gửi đến Bên-Ha-đát vua A-ram, đang trị vì tại Đa-mách, với lời nhắn:
vi.R: Vậy A-sa lấy bạc và vàng ra khỏi các phòng chứa báu vật của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và của cung vua. Vua gửi đến Bên-Ha-đát, vua A-ram, đang cai trị tại Đa-mách. A-sa nhắn với vua ấy:

ko.L: 그리고 아사가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕의 집 보물 창고에서 은과 금을 꺼내어, 다메섹에 사는 아람 왕 벤하닷에게 보내며 말했다.
ko.B: 그러자 아사는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕궁의 보물 창고에서 은과 금을 꺼내어, 다메섹에서 다스리는 아람 왕 벤하닷에게 보내며 이렇게 전하게 했다.
ko.R: 그래서 아사는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 왕궁의 보물 창고에서 은과 금을 꺼냈다. 그리고 그것을 다메섹에서 다스리는 아람 왕 벤하닷에게 보냈다. 아사는 그에게 이런 말을 전하게 했다.

decisions.choice: a shorter form of 1 Kings 15:18
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 15:18 says Asa took "all" the silver and gold "that remained" in the treasuries, gave it to his servants and sent them, and it names Ben-hadad's father and grandfather. Chronicles says only that Asa brought out silver and gold and sent it. The sense of the deal is the same: the temple's wealth is paid to a foreign king.

decisions.choice: Ben-hadad king of Aram, who lived in Damascus
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:18: Aram was the kingdom of the Arameans north and east of Israel, with its capital at Damascus. "Dwelling in" a city, said of a king, means ruling from it. Chronicles spells Damascus with a longer form of the name, found in the later books.

decisions.choice: sent: sent the silver and gold
decisions.reason: The verb has no object; what Asa sent is the silver and gold just named. Kings has him send his servants with it.

decisions.choice: [it] (Literal); it (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: English needs the object the Hebrew leaves understood (m3); Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: who ruled in Damascus (Balanced); who ruled from Damascus (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:18: "lived in" said of a king means he ruled from that city (m2).

source.text: בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ וּבֵ֥ין אָבִ֖י וּבֵ֣ין אָבִ֑יךָ הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּֽי לְךָ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב לֵ֞ךְ הָפֵ֣ר בְּרִֽיתְךָ֗ אֶת־בַּעְשָׁא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: A covenant [is] between me and between you, and between my father and between your father. Look, I have sent to you silver and gold. Go, break your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, and he will go up from on me.

en.L: "[There is] a treaty between me and you, and between my father and your father. Look, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will go up from me."
en.B: "Let there be a treaty between you and me, as there was between my father and your father. I am sending you silver and gold. Go and break off your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, and he will withdraw from me."
en.R: "Let us make a treaty with each other, as our fathers did. I am sending you silver and gold. Break off your treaty with Baasha king of Israel. Then he will pull his army back from my land."

es.L: «[Hay] un pacto entre tú y yo, y entre mi padre y tu padre. He aquí que te he enviado plata y oro. Ve, rompe tu pacto con Baasa rey de Israel, para que se retire de mí».
es.B: «Haya un tratado entre tú y yo, como lo hubo entre mi padre y tu padre. Te envío plata y oro. Ve y rompe tu tratado con Baasa rey de Israel, para que se retire de mi territorio».
es.R: «Hagamos un tratado entre nosotros, como lo hicieron nuestros padres. Te envío plata y oro. Rompe tu tratado con Baasa rey de Israel. Así él retirará su ejército de mi tierra».

fr.L: « [Il y a] une alliance entre moi et toi, et entre mon père et ton père. Voici, je t’envoie de l’argent et de l’or. Va, romps ton alliance avec Baésha, roi d’Israël, pour qu’il se retire de chez moi. »
fr.B: « Qu’il y ait une alliance entre toi et moi, comme il y en avait une entre mon père et ton père. Je t’envoie de l’argent et de l’or. Va, romps ton alliance avec Baésha, roi d’Israël, et il se retirera de chez moi. »
fr.R: « Faisons une alliance ensemble, comme nos pères l’ont fait. Je t’envoie de l’argent et de l’or. Romps ton alliance avec Baésha, roi d’Israël. Alors il retirera son armée de mon pays. »

sw.L: "[Kuna] agano kati yangu na wewe, na kati ya baba yangu na baba yako. Tazama, nimekuletea fedha na dhahabu. Nenda, uvunje agano lako na Baasha mfalme wa Israeli, ili aondoke kwangu."
sw.B: "Na pawe na agano kati yangu na wewe, kama lilivyokuwa kati ya baba yangu na baba yako. Ninakuletea fedha na dhahabu. Nenda ukavunje agano lako na Baasha mfalme wa Israeli, naye ataniondokea."
sw.R: "Na tufanye mkataba sisi wawili, kama baba zetu walivyofanya. Ninakuletea fedha na dhahabu. Vunja mkataba wako na Baasha mfalme wa Israeli. Ndipo atakapoliondoa jeshi lake katika nchi yangu."

vi.L: "[Có] giao ước giữa tôi và vua, giữa cha tôi và cha vua. Kìa, tôi gửi đến vua bạc và vàng. Hãy đi hủy bỏ giao ước của vua với Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, để hắn rút lui khỏi tôi."
vi.B: "Chúng ta hãy lập giao ước với nhau, như đã có giữa cha tôi và cha vua. Tôi gửi đến vua bạc và vàng. Xin vua hãy hủy bỏ giao ước với Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, để hắn rút quân khỏi đất tôi."
vi.R: "Chúng ta hãy lập hiệp ước với nhau, như cha ông chúng ta đã làm. Tôi gửi đến vua bạc và vàng. Xin vua hủy bỏ hiệp ước với Ba-ê-sa vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Khi ấy hắn sẽ rút quân khỏi đất tôi."

ko.L: "나와 당신 사이에, 내 아버지와 당신 아버지 사이에 조약이 [있소]. 보시오, 내가 당신에게 은과 금을 보냈소. 가서 이스라엘 왕 바아사와 맺은 당신의 조약을 깨뜨리시오. 그러면 그가 나에게서 물러갈 것이오."
ko.B: "내 아버지와 당신 아버지 사이에 조약이 있었던 것처럼, 당신과 나 사이에도 조약을 맺읍시다. 내가 당신에게 은과 금을 보내오. 가서 이스라엘 왕 바아사와 맺은 조약을 깨뜨리시오. 그러면 그가 나에게서 물러갈 것이오."
ko.R: "우리 아버지들이 그랬던 것처럼 우리도 서로 조약을 맺읍시다. 내가 당신에게 은과 금을 보내오. 이스라엘 왕 바아사와 맺은 조약을 깨뜨리시오. 그러면 바아사가 내 땅에서 군대를 거두어 물러갈 것이오."

decisions.choice: a treaty between me and you: a request for a treaty like the one their fathers had
alternatives: there is a treaty between me and you, as between my father and your father
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:19. The Hebrew has no verb. It may state that a treaty already stands, or ask that one be made on the model of the fathers' treaty. Since Ben-hadad has a treaty with Baasha that he must break, Asa is most likely asking him to change sides.

decisions.choice: silver and gold, where 1 Kings 15:19 has "a bribe of silver and gold"
decisions.reason: Kings calls the payment a bribe, a word for a payment that buys a decision. Chronicles leaves that word out and lets the seer's rebuke judge the deal instead (verses 7-9). The payment itself is the same.

decisions.choice: he will go up from on me: he will withdraw his forces from my territory
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:19: to go up from someone is to break off an attack and withdraw. Asa wants Baasha to leave Ramah and Judah's border (verse 1).

decisions.choice: as our fathers did
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:19, Readable puts "between my father and your father" into a shorter phrase with the same meaning.

decisions.choice: pull his army back from my land
decisions.reason: Readable says what "go up from me" means (m3).

decisions.choice: "pacto" (L); "tratado" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 15:19 and 20:34: a covenant between kings is "pacto" at Literal and "tratado" at Balanced and Readable; Chronicles leaves out "bribe" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: agano (Literal, Balanced); mkataba (Readable)
decisions.reason: A treaty between kings is "agano" at Literal and Balanced and "mkataba" at Readable, as in the Swahili 1 Kings 15:19.

decisions.choice: "bạc và vàng" without "món hối lộ"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has silver and gold where 1 Kings 15:19 calls it a bribe (m2); the rest keeps the Vietnamese of Kings.

decisions.choice: One king writes to another in 하오체 with "당신"; "뇌물로" dropped
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 15:19; Chronicles says only "silver and gold" where Kings has "a bribe" (m2).

records.literal_gloss: And listened Ben-hadad to the king Asa, and he sent [the] commanders of the forces which [were] his against [the] cities of Israel, and they struck Ijon and Dan and Abel-maim and all [the] stores of [the] cities of Naphtali.

en.L: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa, and he sent the commanders of the forces that [were] his against the cities of Israel, and they struck Ijon and Dan and Abel-maim and all the stores of the cities of Naphtali.
en.B: Ben-hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces out against the cities of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim and all the store cities of Naphtali.
en.R: Ben-hadad agreed to what King Asa asked. He sent the commanders of his armies to attack the towns of Israel. They defeated Ijon, Dan and Abel-maim, and all the towns of Naphtali where supplies were stored.

es.L: Y Ben-adad escuchó al rey Asá, y envió a los jefes de los ejércitos que [eran] suyos contra las ciudades de Israel, e hirieron a Ijón, a Dan, a Abel-maim y a todas las ciudades de almacenes de Neftalí.
es.B: Ben-adad estuvo de acuerdo con el rey Asá y envió a los jefes de sus ejércitos contra las ciudades de Israel. Conquistaron Ijón, Dan, Abel-maim y todas las ciudades de almacenes de Neftalí.
es.R: Ben-adad aceptó lo que le pedía el rey Asá. Envió a los jefes de sus ejércitos a atacar las ciudades de Israel. Derrotaron a Ijón, Dan y Abel-maim, y todos los pueblos de Neftalí donde se guardaban provisiones.

fr.L: Et Ben-Hadad écouta le roi Asa, et il envoya les chefs des armées qu’il avait contre les villes d’Israël, et ils frappèrent Iyyôn, et Dan, et Abel-Maïm, et tous les entrepôts des villes de Nephtali.
fr.B: Ben-Hadad accepta la proposition du roi Asa et envoya les chefs de ses armées contre les villes d’Israël. Ils conquirent Iyyôn, Dan, Abel-Maïm et toutes les villes d’entrepôts de Nephtali.
fr.R: Ben-Hadad a accepté ce que le roi Asa lui demandait. Il a envoyé les chefs de ses armées attaquer les villes d’Israël. Ils ont vaincu Iyyôn, Dan, Abel-Maïm, et toutes les villes de Nephtali où l’on gardait des provisions.

sw.L: Ben-hadadi akamsikiliza mfalme Asa, akawatuma wakuu wa majeshi yaliyokuwa yake dhidi ya miji ya Israeli, nao wakapiga Iyoni na Dani na Abel-maimu na ghala zote za miji ya Naftali.
sw.B: Ben-hadadi akakubali maneno ya mfalme Asa, akawatuma wakuu wa majeshi yake kushambulia miji ya Israeli. Wakaiteka Iyoni, Dani, Abel-maimu na miji yote ya ghala ya Naftali.
sw.R: Ben-hadadi akakubali yale aliyoomba mfalme Asa. Akawatuma makamanda wa majeshi yake kushambulia miji ya Israeli. Wakaishinda Iyoni, Dani na Abel-maimu, na miji yote ya Naftali walimohifadhi mahitaji.

vi.L: Bên-Ha-đát nghe theo vua A-sa, sai các tướng chỉ huy quân lực của mình đi đánh các thành của Y-sơ-ra-ên; họ đánh Y-giôn, Đan, A-bên Ma-im và tất cả các kho của các thành Nép-ta-li.
vi.B: Bên-Ha-đát nghe theo vua A-sa và sai các tướng chỉ huy quân lực mình đi đánh các thành của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ chiếm Y-giôn, Đan, A-bên Ma-im và tất cả các thành kho của Nép-ta-li.
vi.R: Bên-Ha-đát đồng ý với lời yêu cầu của vua A-sa. Ông sai các tướng chỉ huy quân đội mình tấn công các thành của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ chiếm được Y-giôn, Đan, A-bên Ma-im và tất cả các thành của Nép-ta-li là nơi chứa lương thực.

ko.L: 그리고 벤하닷이 아사 왕의 말을 듣고, 자기에게 속한 군대 지휘관들을 이스라엘의 성읍들로 보내어 이욘과 단과 아벨마임과 납달리 성읍들의 모든 국고를 쳤다.
ko.B: 벤하닷은 아사 왕의 말에 동의하여, 자기 군대 지휘관들을 보내 이스라엘의 성읍들을 치게 했다. 그들은 이욘과 단과 아벨마임과 납달리의 모든 국고 성읍을 정복했다.
ko.R: 벤하닷은 아사 왕이 부탁한 대로 했다. 그는 자기 군대 지휘관들을 보내 이스라엘의 성읍들을 공격하게 했다. 그들은 이욘과 단과 아벨마임을 쳐부수었고, 물자를 쌓아 두던 납달리의 모든 성읍도 쳐부수었다.

decisions.choice: Abel-maim and the store cities of Naphtali, where 1 Kings 15:20 has Abel-beth-maacah, all Chinneroth and all the land of Naphtali
decisions.reason: Abel-maim, "Abel of the waters", is another name for Abel-beth-maacah, a town in the far north near the sources of the Jordan (compare 2 Samuel 20:14-18). In place of "all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali", Chronicles has "all the stores of the cities of Naphtali". The Hebrew words for "Chinneroth" and "stores" look alike, so one wording may have grown from the other in copying, but each makes sense as it stands. Chronicles also makes the commanders the ones who struck the towns, where Kings says Ben-hadad struck them.

decisions.choice: the stores of the cities: towns or buildings where supplies were kept
alternatives: the storehouses in the towns of Naphtali
decisions.reason: The word means supplies or storehouses. The same word with "cities" names Solomon's store cities (1 Kings 9:19; 2 Chronicles 8:4, 6), so the phrase means the towns of Naphtali used as supply bases, or the stores held in them.

decisions.choice: listened to: agreed to; struck: attacked and defeated
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:20: to listen to a request is to agree to it, and to strike towns is to attack and conquer them.

decisions.choice: Ijon, Dan, Naphtali: the far north of Israel
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:20: these places lay on the road south from Aram into Israel. Naphtali was the tribal land west of the lake later called the Sea of Galilee.

decisions.choice: agreed with, conquered, store cities (Balanced); agreed to, defeated (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:20, Balanced and Readable say what "listened" and "struck" mean here (m3). "Store cities" is the term used for Solomon's supply towns (m2).

decisions.choice: the towns of Naphtali where supplies were stored
decisions.reason: Readable explains "store cities" (m2).

decisions.choice: "Abel-maim"
decisions.reason: Chronicles names the town Abel-maim where 1 Kings 15:20 has Abel-beth-maacah (meaning decision); Spanish keeps the form of each book.

decisions.choice: "A-bên Ma-im"
decisions.reason: Chronicles names Abel-maim where 1 Kings 15:20 has Abel-beth-maacah (m1); each verse keeps its own name.

decisions.choice: "아벨마임"; "국고" (L), "국고 성읍" (B), "물자를 쌓아 두던 성읍" (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles names Abel-maim and the store cities of Naphtali (m1); Korean follows its Hebrew.

records.literal_gloss: And it was as heard Baasha, and he ceased from building the Ramah, and he caused to cease his work.

en.L: And it happened, when Baasha heard [of it], that he stopped building Ramah, and he brought his work to a halt.
en.B: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.
en.R: When Baasha heard about this, he stopped building Ramah. He left his work there unfinished.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando [lo] oyó Baasa, dejó de edificar Ramá, y suspendió su obra.
es.B: Cuando Baasa se enteró, dejó de fortificar Ramá y abandonó su obra.
es.R: Cuando Baasa se enteró de esto, dejó de construir en Ramá. Dejó su obra allí sin terminar.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Baésha [l’]apprit, qu’il cessa de bâtir Rama, et il arrêta son ouvrage.
fr.B: Quand Baésha l’apprit, il cessa de fortifier Rama et abandonna son ouvrage.
fr.R: Quand Baésha l’a appris, il a arrêté de construire Rama. Il a laissé son travail inachevé.

sw.L: Ikawa, Baasha aliposikia [habari hiyo], akaacha kuijenga Rama, akaisimamisha kazi yake.
sw.B: Baasha aliposikia habari hiyo, aliacha kuijenga Rama, akaiacha kazi yake.
sw.R: Baasha aliposikia habari hiyo, aliacha kuijenga Rama. Akaiacha kazi yake huko bila kuimaliza.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi Ba-ê-sa nghe [tin ấy], thì ông ngưng xây Ra-ma, và cho dừng công việc của mình.
vi.B: Khi Ba-ê-sa nghe tin ấy, vua ngưng xây Ra-ma và bỏ dở công việc của mình.
vi.R: Khi Ba-ê-sa nghe tin ấy, vua ngưng việc xây Ra-ma. Vua bỏ dở công việc ở đó.

ko.L: 그리고 바아사가 [그 소식을] 들었을 때, 그가 라마를 건축하던 일을 멈추고 그의 일을 그쳤다.
ko.B: 바아사는 그 소식을 듣고 라마를 쌓던 일을 멈추고 공사를 그만두었다.
ko.R: 바아사는 이 소식을 듣고 라마를 쌓던 일을 멈추었다. 그는 그곳의 공사를 마치지 못하고 그만두었다.

decisions.choice: he made his work cease, where 1 Kings 15:21 has "and he stayed in Tirzah"
decisions.reason: The first half of the verse is the same as Kings. For its close Chronicles says that Baasha brought his work to an end, instead of saying that he stayed in his capital, Tirzah. Both mean that he gave up the fortress at Ramah.

decisions.choice: heard: heard of Ben-hadad's attack
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:21: the verb has no object; what Baasha heard is the news of verse 4.

decisions.choice: [of it]
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:21, Literal brackets the object English needs (m2).

records.literal_gloss: And Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away [the] stones of the Ramah and its timbers which had built Baasha, and he built with them Geba and the Mizpah.

en.L: And Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and its timbers with which Baasha had built, and he built with them Geba and Mizpah.
en.B: Then King Asa brought all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber Baasha had used to build Ramah. With them he fortified Geba and Mizpah.
en.R: Then King Asa called out all the men of Judah. They carried away the stones and wood that Baasha had been using at Ramah. Asa used them to build up the towns of Geba and Mizpah.

es.L: Y el rey Asá tomó a todo Judá, y se llevaron las piedras de Ramá y su madera con que Baasa edificaba, y con ellas edificó Geba y Mizpa.
es.B: Entonces el rey Asá llevó a todo Judá, y se llevaron las piedras y la madera que Baasa había usado para fortificar Ramá. Con ellas fortificó Geba y Mizpa.
es.R: Entonces el rey Asá llamó a todos los hombres de Judá. Se llevaron las piedras y la madera que Baasa estaba usando en Ramá. Asá las usó para fortificar los pueblos de Geba y Mizpa.

fr.L: Et le roi Asa prit tout Juda, et ils emportèrent les pierres de Rama et son bois, avec lesquels Baésha avait bâti ; et il bâtit avec eux Guéba et Mitspa.
fr.B: Alors le roi Asa emmena tout Juda, et on emporta les pierres et le bois que Baésha avait utilisés pour fortifier Rama. Il s’en servit pour fortifier Guéba et Mitspa.
fr.R: Ensuite le roi Asa a appelé tous les hommes de Juda. Ils ont emporté les pierres et le bois que Baésha utilisait à Rama. Asa s’en est servi pour fortifier les villes de Guéba et de Mitspa.

sw.L: Mfalme Asa akawachukua Yuda wote, nao wakayachukua mawe ya Rama na miti yake ambayo Baasha alikuwa amejengea, naye akajenga kwa hivyo Geba na Mizpa.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme Asa akawaleta Yuda wote, nao wakayabeba mawe na miti ambayo Baasha alitumia kuijenga Rama. Kwa vitu hivyo akaiimarisha Geba na Mizpa.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme Asa akawaita wanaume wote wa Yuda. Wakayabeba mawe na miti ambayo Baasha alikuwa akiitumia huko Rama. Asa akavitumia kuijenga miji ya Geba na Mizpa iwe imara.

vi.L: Vua A-sa đem cả Giu-đa, và họ khuân đi đá và gỗ của Ra-ma mà Ba-ê-sa đã dùng để xây; với những thứ đó vua xây Ghê-ba và Mích-ba.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua A-sa đem toàn dân Giu-đa đến, và họ khuân đi đá và gỗ Ba-ê-sa đã dùng để xây Ra-ma. Vua dùng những thứ ấy để củng cố Ghê-ba và Mích-ba.
vi.R: Rồi vua A-sa kêu gọi mọi người nam trong Giu-đa. Họ khuân đi đá và gỗ mà Ba-ê-sa đang dùng để xây Ra-ma. A-sa dùng những thứ ấy để xây cho các thành Ghê-ba và Mích-ba vững mạnh hơn.

ko.L: 그리고 아사 왕이 온 유다를 데려왔고, 그들이 바아사가 건축하던 라마의 돌들과 목재들을 실어 왔다. 그리고 그가 그것들로 게바와 미스바를 건축했다.
ko.B: 그러자 아사 왕은 온 유다를 데려왔다. 그들은 바아사가 라마를 쌓는 데 쓰던 돌과 목재를 실어 왔다. 아사는 그것으로 게바와 미스바를 요새로 만들었다.
ko.R: 그러자 아사 왕은 유다의 모든 남자를 불러 모았다. 그들은 바아사가 라마에서 쓰던 돌과 나무를 실어 왔다. 아사는 그것으로 게바와 미스바 성읍을 튼튼하게 쌓았다.

decisions.choice: took all Judah, where 1 Kings 15:22 has "summoned all Judah, none exempt"; Geba, where Kings has "Geba of Benjamin"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says Asa took all Judah with him to the work, where Kings says he called them up by public order and released no one. Chronicles also leaves out "of Benjamin" after Geba. The rest of the verse matches Kings.

decisions.choice: Geba and Mizpah: border towns north of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:22: both towns lay on Judah's northern border near Ramah. Asa turned Baasha's materials into his own defense line (compare Jeremiah 41:9).

decisions.choice: built: fortified
decisions.reason: As in verse 1, the verb means building up existing towns as strongholds.

decisions.choice: all the men of Judah
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 15:22, Readable says "men" because those who did heavy building work were the men of Judah; the Hebrew is "all Judah".

decisions.choice: brought, fortified (Balanced); called out, build up (Readable)
decisions.reason: Asa took the people with him to do the work, and the building was a fortifying of existing towns (m3).

source.text: וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא בָּ֚א חֲנָ֣נִי הָרֹאֶ֔ה אֶל־אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו בְּהִשָּׁ֨עֶנְךָ֜ עַל־מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲרָם֙ וְלֹ֤א נִשְׁעַ֨נְתָּ֙ עַל־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־כֵּ֗ן נִמְלַ֛ט חֵ֥יל מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָ֖ם מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And at the time the that came Hanani the seer to Asa king of Judah, and he said to him, Because of your relying on [the] king of Aram and not you relied on Yahweh your God, therefore has escaped [the] army of [the] king of Aram from your hand.

en.L: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him, "Because you relied on the king of Aram and did not rely on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, therefore the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.
en.B: At that time the seer Hanani came to Asa king of Judah and told him, "You relied on the king of Aram and did not rely on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Because of that, the army of the king of Aram has slipped out of your hand.
en.R: At that time Hanani the seer, a prophet, came to Asa king of Judah. He said to him, "You trusted the king of Aram to help you, and you did not trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. That is why the army of the king of Aram has gotten away from you.

es.L: Y en aquel tiempo vino Hananí el vidente a Asá rey de Judá, y le dijo: «Por cuanto te apoyaste en el rey de Aram y no te apoyaste en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, por eso el ejército del rey de Aram se ha escapado de tu mano.
es.B: En aquel tiempo el vidente Hananí vino a Asá rey de Judá y le dijo: «Te apoyaste en el rey de Aram y no te apoyaste en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. Por eso el ejército del rey de Aram se te ha escapado de las manos.
es.R: En aquel tiempo Hananí el vidente, un profeta, vino a ver a Asá rey de Judá. Le dijo: «Confiaste en que el rey de Aram te ayudaría, y no confiaste en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. Por eso el ejército del rey de Aram se te ha escapado.

fr.L: Et en ce temps-là, Hanani le voyant vint vers Asa, roi de Juda, et lui dit : « Parce que tu t’es appuyé sur le roi d’Aram et que tu ne t’es pas appuyé sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, à cause de cela, l’armée du roi d’Aram a échappé à ta main.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, le voyant Hanani vint trouver Asa, roi de Juda, et lui dit : « Tu t’es appuyé sur le roi d’Aram, et tu ne t’es pas appuyé sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. C’est pourquoi l’armée du roi d’Aram t’a échappé.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, Hanani le voyant, un prophète, est venu voir Asa, roi de Juda. Il lui a dit : « Tu as compté sur le roi d’Aram pour t’aider, et tu n’as pas compté sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. C’est pour cela que l’armée du roi d’Aram t’a échappé.

sw.L: Wakati ule Hanani mwonaji akaja kwa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, akamwambia, "Kwa sababu ulimtegemea mfalme wa Aramu wala hukumtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kwa hiyo jeshi la mfalme wa Aramu limeponyoka mkononi mwako.
sw.B: Wakati ule mwonaji Hanani alikuja kwa Asa mfalme wa Yuda, akamwambia, "Ulimtegemea mfalme wa Aramu wala hukumtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Kwa sababu hiyo, jeshi la mfalme wa Aramu limekuponyoka.
sw.R: Wakati ule Hanani mwonaji, yaani nabii, alikuja kwa Asa mfalme wa Yuda. Akamwambia, "Ulimtumaini mfalme wa Aramu akusaidie, wala hukumtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Ndiyo sababu jeshi la mfalme wa Aramu limekutoroka.

vi.L: Lúc ấy nhà tiên kiến Ha-na-ni đến cùng A-sa vua Giu-đa và nói với vua: "Vì vua đã nương cậy vua A-ram mà không nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua, nên đạo quân của vua A-ram đã thoát khỏi tay vua.
vi.B: Lúc ấy nhà tiên kiến Ha-na-ni đến gặp A-sa vua Giu-đa và nói với vua: "Vua đã nương cậy vua A-ram mà không nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua. Vì thế, đạo quân của vua A-ram đã thoát khỏi tay vua.
vi.R: Lúc ấy nhà tiên kiến Ha-na-ni, một nhà tiên tri, đến gặp A-sa vua Giu-đa. Ông nói với vua: "Vua đã tin cậy vua A-ram giúp mình, mà không tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của vua. Vì thế, đạo quân của vua A-ram đã thoát khỏi tay vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그때 선견자 하나니가 유다 왕 아사에게 와서 그에게 말했다. "임금님께서 아람 왕을 의지하시고 임금님의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 의지하지 않으셨으므로, 아람 왕의 군대가 임금님의 손에서 벗어났습니다.
ko.B: 그때 선견자 하나니가 유다 왕 아사에게 와서 말했다. "임금님께서는 아람 왕을 의지하시고 임금님의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 의지하지 않으셨습니다. 그래서 아람 왕의 군대가 임금님의 손에서 빠져나갔습니다.
ko.R: 그때 예언자인 선견자 하나니가 유다 왕 아사에게 와서 말했다. "임금님께서는 아람 왕이 도와주리라고 믿으시고, 임금님의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿지 않으셨습니다. 그래서 아람 왕의 군대가 임금님에게서 빠져나갔습니다.

decisions.choice: Hanani the seer: a prophet, the father of the prophet Jehu
decisions.reason: Verses 7-10 have no parallel in Kings. "Seer" is an older title for a prophet, one to whom God shows things (1 Samuel 9:9). Hanani's son Jehu spoke against Baasha (1 Kings 16:1, 7) and later rebuked Asa's son Jehoshaphat (2 Chronicles 19:2).

decisions.choice: relied: leaned on for help
decisions.reason: The verb means to lean on or support oneself on someone. It is the word Asa used in his prayer before the battle with the Cushites: "we rely on you" (14:10). The seer sets that earlier trust against Asa's present reliance on a foreign king. The same contrast appears in Abijah's victory (13:18).

decisions.choice: the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand: Asa lost the chance to defeat Aram as well
alternatives: Aram, as Israel's ally, would have fallen into Asa's hands together with Israel
decisions.reason: Had Asa relied on the LORD, he would have overcome not only Baasha but also Baasha's ally Aram, as he had overcome the Cushites (verse 8). By buying Aram as a friend he let a future enemy of Judah go free.

decisions.choice: two sentences in place of "because ... therefore"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the cause first as its own sentence, then the result, which keeps the long sentence easy to follow.

decisions.choice: the seer, a prophet; trusted ... to help you
decisions.reason: Readable explains "seer" at its first use in this book and says what relying on the king meant (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: "Hananí el vidente"
decisions.reason: Hanani takes the form of the Spanish of 1 Kings 16:1 (Jehú hijo de Hananí); "vidente" follows the Samuel terms note for the seer.

decisions.choice: "te apoyaste" (L, B); "confiaste" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is leaning on someone, the word Asa used in his prayer (meaning decision; 14:10); Literal and Balanced keep the image, as in 14:10.

decisions.choice: "le voyant" (every level, R adds "un prophète"); "s'appuyer sur" (L, B), "compter sur" (R)
decisions.reason: "Voyant" as the Samuel note has it for *roʾeh* and *ḥozeh*. The verb of leaning is "s'appuyer sur" at Literal and Balanced, as at 13:18, and "compter sur" at Readable, as the English Readable says "trusted".

decisions.choice: the seer calls Asa "vua"
decisions.reason: Prophets speak to the king as "vua" in these books (terms note), even in a rebuke; "nương cậy" (L, B), "tin cậy" (R) for relying (m2).

decisions.choice: Hanani the seer speaks to the king in 합쇼체, calling him "임금님"; "선견자"
decisions.reason: Prophets speak to kings in 합쇼체, as the terms note says, even in rebuke.

source.text: הֲלֹ֧א הַכּוּשִׁ֣ים וְהַלּוּבִ֗ים הָי֨וּ לְחַ֧יִל׀לָרֹ֛ב לְרֶ֥כֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁ֖ים לְהַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּבְהִשָּֽׁעֶנְךָ֥ עַל־יְהוָ֖ה נְתָנָ֥ם בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [Were] not the Cushites and the Libyans for an army in multitude, with chariotry and with horsemen to abundance very? And because of your relying on Yahweh he gave them into your hand.

en.L: Were not the Cushites and the Libyans an army in multitude, with chariots and with horsemen in very great abundance? And because you relied on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them into your hand.
en.B: Were not the Cushites and the Libyans a huge army, with chariots and horsemen in great numbers? But you relied on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} handed them over to you.
en.R: Think of the Cushites and the Libyans. They had a huge army with very many chariots and horsemen. But because you trusted {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let you defeat them.

es.L: ¿No eran los cusitas y los libios un ejército numeroso, con carros y con jinetes en gran abundancia? Pero porque te apoyaste en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los entregó en tu mano.
es.B: ¿No eran los cusitas y los libios un ejército enorme, con muchísimos carros y jinetes? Pero te apoyaste en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te los entregó.
es.R: Piensa en los cusitas y los libios. Tenían un ejército enorme, con muchísimos carros y jinetes. Pero como confiaste en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te dejó vencerlos.

fr.L: Les Koushites et les Libyens n’étaient-ils pas une armée nombreuse, avec des chars et des cavaliers en très grande quantité ? Et parce que tu t’es appuyé sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a livrés entre tes mains.
fr.B: Les Koushites et les Libyens ne formaient-ils pas une immense armée, avec des chars et des cavaliers en grand nombre ? Mais tu t’es appuyé sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te les a livrés.
fr.R: Pense aux Koushites et aux Libyens. Ils avaient une immense armée, avec énormément de chars et de cavaliers. Mais parce que tu as compté sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a permis de les vaincre.

sw.L: Je, Wakushi na Walibia hawakuwa jeshi kubwa, wenye magari ya vita na wapanda farasi wengi mno? Na kwa sababu ulimtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliwatia mkononi mwako.
sw.B: Je, Wakushi na Walibia hawakuwa jeshi kubwa sana, lenye magari ya vita na wapanda farasi wengi mno? Lakini wewe ulimtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye akawatia mikononi mwako.
sw.R: Wakumbuke Wakushi na Walibia. Walikuwa na jeshi kubwa lenye magari ya vita na wapanda farasi wengi sana. Lakini kwa sababu ulimtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alikuwezesha kuwashinda.

vi.L: Chẳng phải người Cút và người Li-by là một đạo quân đông đảo, với xe chiến mã và kỵ binh rất nhiều sao? Nhưng vì vua đã nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phó họ vào tay vua.
vi.B: Chẳng phải người Cút và người Li-by là một đạo quân đông đảo, với rất nhiều xe chiến mã và kỵ binh sao? Nhưng vua đã nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phó họ vào tay vua.
vi.R: Hãy nhớ lại người Cút và người Li-by. Họ có một đạo quân rất lớn với rất nhiều xe chiến mã và kỵ binh. Nhưng vì vua đã tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho vua đánh bại họ.

ko.L: 구스 사람들과 리비아 사람들은 병거와 기병이 매우 많은 큰 군대가 아니었습니까? 그러나 임금님께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 의지하셨으므로 그분께서 그들을 임금님의 손에 넘겨주셨습니다.
ko.B: 구스 사람들과 리비아 사람들은 병거와 기병이 아주 많은 큰 군대가 아니었습니까? 그러나 임금님께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 의지하셨기 때문에, 그분께서 그들을 임금님의 손에 넘겨주셨습니다.
ko.R: 구스 사람들과 리비아 사람들을 생각해 보십시오. 그들은 병거와 기병이 아주 많은 큰 군대였습니다. 그러나 임금님께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿으셨기 때문에, 그분께서 임금님이 그들을 이기게 해 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: the Cushites and the Libyans: the army of Zerah the Cushite defeated in 14:8-14
decisions.reason: Zerah the Cushite came against Asa with a vast army, and the LORD struck it down when Asa cried to him (14:8-14). Cush was the land south of Egypt along the Nile. Chapter 14 does not name the Libyans; the seer adds that they were part of that army, as they had been in Shishak's army (12:3).

decisions.choice: were not ...?: a question expecting the answer yes
decisions.reason: The seer reminds Asa of what he already knows: the army was huge, and yet the LORD gave it to him.

decisions.choice: gave them into your hand: let you defeat them
decisions.reason: To give enemies into someone's hand is to give him victory over them.

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into a reminder, which is what it means (m2).

decisions.choice: handed them over to you (Balanced); let you defeat them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m3).

source.text: כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה עֵינָ֞יו מְשֹׁטְט֤וֹת בְּכָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ לְ֠הִתְחַזֵּק עִם־לְבָבָ֥ם שָׁלֵ֛ם אֵלָ֖יו נִסְכַּ֣לְתָּ עַל־זֹ֑את כִּ֣י מֵעַ֔תָּה יֵ֥שׁ עִמְּךָ֖ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: For Yahweh, his eyes [are] roaming in all the earth to show himself strong with [those whose] heart [is] whole toward him. You have acted foolishly about this, for from now [there are] with you wars.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes roam through all the earth, to show {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} strong for [those whose] heart [is] whole toward {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. You have acted foolishly in this, for from now on [there will be] wars with you."
en.B: For the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} roam over all the earth, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strength for those whose hearts are undivided toward {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. You have acted foolishly in this matter, and from this time on you will face wars."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s eyes look all over the earth, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} can use {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power to help people who are completely loyal to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. What you did was foolish. From now on you will have to fight wars."

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos recorren toda la tierra, para mostrarse fuerte a favor de [aquellos cuyo] corazón [es] íntegro para con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Has obrado neciamente en esto, porque desde ahora [habrá] guerras contra ti».
es.B: Porque los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} recorren toda la tierra, para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder a favor de los que tienen un corazón íntegro para con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Has actuado neciamente en esto, y desde ahora tendrás guerras».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mira por toda la tierra, para usar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder en ayuda de los que le son completamente leales. Lo que hiciste fue una necedad. Desde ahora tendrás que pelear guerras».

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux parcourent toute la terre, pour {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} montrer fort en faveur de [ceux dont] le cœur [est] entier envers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Tu as agi en insensé en cela, car désormais [il y aura] des guerres contre toi. »
fr.B: Car les yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} parcourent toute la terre, afin qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force en faveur de ceux dont le cœur est sans partage envers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Tu as agi en insensé dans cette affaire, et désormais tu auras des guerres. »
fr.R: Les yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} regardent partout sur la terre, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} puisse {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} servir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance pour aider ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont entièrement fidèles. Ce que tu as fait était stupide. À partir de maintenant, tu devras faire la guerre. »

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, macho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yanazunguka duniani kote, ili kujionyesha hodari kwa ajili ya [wale ambao] moyo [wao ni] mkamilifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Umetenda kwa upumbavu katika jambo hili, kwa maana tangu sasa [kutakuwa na] vita juu yako."
sw.B: Kwa maana macho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yanazunguka duniani kote, ili aonyeshe nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa ajili ya wale ambao mioyo yao imejitoa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} kikamilifu. Umetenda kwa upumbavu katika jambo hili, na tangu sasa utakabiliwa na vita."
sw.R: Macho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yanaangalia dunia yote, ili atumie uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuwasaidia watu walio waaminifu kabisa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Ulichofanya ni upumbavu. Tangu sasa utalazimika kupigana vita."

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhìn khắp cả trái đất, để tỏ ra quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho [những người có] lòng trọn vẹn với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Trong việc này vua đã hành động dại dột, vì từ nay về sau vua sẽ có chiến tranh."
vi.B: Vì mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn khắp cả trái đất, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ quyền năng mình ra giúp những người có lòng trọn vẹn với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Trong việc này vua đã hành động dại dột, và từ nay về sau vua sẽ phải đối mặt với chiến tranh."
vi.R: Mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn khắp cả trái đất, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dùng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp những người hết lòng trung thành với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Việc vua làm thật là dại dột. Từ nay về sau vua sẽ phải đánh nhau liên miên."

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 눈이 온 땅을 두루 살피셔서, 그분을 향하여 마음이 온전한 사람들을 위하여 그분의 힘을 나타내십니다. 임금님께서는 이 일에 어리석게 행하셨습니다. 이제부터 임금님께 전쟁이 있을 것입니다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈은 온 땅을 두루 살피시어, 그분께 마음을 온전히 바치는 사람들을 위하여 힘을 나타내십니다. 임금님께서는 이 일에 어리석게 행하셨습니다. 이제부터 임금님은 늘 전쟁을 겪으실 것입니다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 온 세상을 두루 살피십니다. 그분께 온전히 충성하는 사람들을 그분의 능력으로 도우시려는 것입니다. 임금님께서 하신 일은 어리석었습니다. 이제부터 임금님은 계속 전쟁을 치르셔야 할 것입니다."

decisions.choice: his eyes roam through all the earth: the LORD sees everything and watches everywhere
decisions.reason: The verb describes going to and fro. The LORD's eyes are pictured going over the whole earth, so nothing escapes him and he finds those who trust him wherever they are. Zechariah 4:10 uses the same picture. The Hebrew puts "the LORD" first for emphasis: "the LORD, his eyes roam".

decisions.choice: to show himself strong for: to use his strength on behalf of
decisions.reason: The verb means to show oneself strong, and with "with" it means acting with strength on someone's side. The purpose of his watching is to help.

decisions.choice: whose heart is whole toward him: wholly devoted, with undivided loyalty
decisions.reason: A whole heart is one that is complete and undivided. 15:17 and 1 Kings 15:14 say that Asa's heart was whole all his days; here the seer measures his trust in Aram against that standard.

decisions.choice: you have acted foolishly ... from now on there will be wars with you: a judgment
decisions.reason: Asa's folly is to have chosen a human ally over God. The wars are the consequence announced for the rest of his reign; 1 Kings 15:16 says there was war between Asa and Baasha all their days.

decisions.choice: look all over the earth; use his power to help; completely loyal
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of the eyes but uses plain words for the roaming, the showing of strength and the whole heart (m1-m3).

decisions.choice: undivided
decisions.reason: Balanced says "undivided" for a whole heart, which keeps the sense of nothing held back (m3).

decisions.choice: "sus ojos recorren toda la tierra" (L); "los ojos del SEÑOR recorren" (B); "mira por toda la tierra" (R)
decisions.reason: The Lord's eyes going to and fro picture his watch over the whole earth (meaning decision); Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "마음이 온전한" (L), "마음을 온전히 바치는" (B), "온전히 충성하는" (R)
decisions.reason: The same phrase as the verdict on Asa's heart (15:17) and 1 Kings 15:3, 14.

source.text: וַיִּכְעַ֨ס אָסָ֜א אֶל־הָרֹאֶ֗ה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֨הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמַּהְפֶּ֔כֶת כִּֽי־בְזַ֥עַף עִמּ֖וֹ עַל־זֹ֑את וַיְרַצֵּ֥ץ אָסָ֛א מִן־הָעָ֖ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And was angry Asa with the seer, and he put him [in the] house of the stocks, for [he was] in a rage with him over this. And crushed Asa some of the people at the time the that.

en.L: And Asa was angry with the seer, and he put him [in] the house of the stocks, for [he was] in a rage with him over this. And Asa crushed some of the people at that time.
en.B: Asa was angry with the seer and put him in prison in the stocks, because he was furious with him over this. And at that time Asa dealt harshly with some of the people.
en.R: Asa was angry with the seer. He was so furious about what Hanani said that he had him locked in the stocks in prison. At that time Asa also treated some of the people cruelly.

es.L: Y se enojó Asá contra el vidente, y lo puso en la casa del cepo, porque estaba enfurecido con él por esto. Y oprimió Asá a algunos del pueblo en aquel tiempo.
es.B: Asá se enojó con el vidente y lo metió en la cárcel, en el cepo, porque estaba furioso con él por esto. Y en aquel tiempo Asá trató con dureza a algunos del pueblo.
es.R: Asá se enojó con el vidente. Estaba tan furioso por lo que Hananí le había dicho que lo hizo encerrar en la cárcel con los pies en el cepo. En aquel tiempo Asá también trató con crueldad a algunos del pueblo.

fr.L: Et Asa fut irrité contre le voyant, et il le mit [dans] la maison des ceps, car [il était] en fureur contre lui à cause de cela. Et Asa opprima une partie du peuple en ce temps-là.
fr.B: Asa fut irrité contre le voyant et le fit mettre en prison, les pieds dans les ceps, tant il était furieux contre lui à ce sujet. Et à ce moment-là, Asa maltraita une partie du peuple.
fr.R: Asa était en colère contre le voyant. Il était tellement furieux de ce que Hanani avait dit qu’il l’a fait enfermer en prison, les pieds pris dans des pièces de bois. À ce moment-là, Asa a aussi traité cruellement une partie du peuple.

sw.L: Asa akamkasirikia mwonaji, akamtia katika nyumba ya mkatale, kwa maana [alikuwa] na ghadhabu juu yake kwa jambo hili. Na Asa akawaonea baadhi ya watu wakati ule.
sw.B: Asa alimkasirikia mwonaji, akamtia gerezani kwenye mkatale, kwa sababu alikuwa na ghadhabu juu yake kwa jambo hili. Na wakati ule Asa aliwatendea baadhi ya watu kwa ukali.
sw.R: Asa alimkasirikia mwonaji. Alikasirishwa sana na yale Hanani aliyosema, hata akaamuru afungwe kwenye mkatale gerezani. Wakati ule Asa aliwatendea pia baadhi ya watu kwa ukatili.

vi.L: A-sa giận nhà tiên kiến và đặt ông [trong] nhà cùm, vì vua giận dữ với ông về việc này. Lúc ấy A-sa cũng đè nén một số người trong dân.
vi.B: A-sa giận nhà tiên kiến và bỏ ông vào ngục, cùm lại, vì vua giận dữ với ông về việc này. Lúc ấy A-sa cũng đối xử hà khắc với một số người trong dân.
vi.R: A-sa giận nhà tiên kiến. Vua giận dữ vì lời Ha-na-ni nói đến nỗi bỏ ông vào ngục và cùm lại. Lúc ấy A-sa cũng đối xử tàn nhẫn với một số người trong dân.

ko.L: 그리고 아사가 그 선견자에게 화가 나서 그를 차꼬를 채우는 집에 가두었다. 이 일 때문에 그에게 몹시 분노했기 때문이다. 그리고 그때 아사가 백성 가운데 몇 사람을 학대했다.
ko.B: 아사는 그 선견자에게 화가 나서 그를 감옥에 가두고 차꼬를 채웠다. 이 일 때문에 그에게 몹시 분노했기 때문이다. 그때 아사는 백성 가운데 몇 사람을 가혹하게 대했다.
ko.R: 아사는 그 선견자에게 화가 났다. 하나니가 한 말 때문에 몹시 분노하여, 그를 감옥에 가두고 차꼬를 채웠다. 그때 아사는 백성 가운데 몇 사람을 잔인하게 대했다.

decisions.choice: the house of the stocks: a prison where the prisoner was held in stocks
alternatives: a frame that held neck and hands
decisions.reason: The word for the device comes from a verb meaning to turn or twist, and seems to name a frame that held the body in a cramped, bent position. Jeremiah was put in the same device (Jeremiah 20:2-3; 29:26). "House of" makes it a place of confinement. Its exact form is not known.

decisions.choice: crushed: oppressed cruelly
alternatives: those who sided with the seer
decisions.reason: The verb means to crush or break, and of people it means to oppress them harshly (1 Samuel 12:3-4; Amos 4:1). The text does not say who these people were or why; they may have been people who took the seer's side.

decisions.choice: Asa's anger: a king who once sought the LORD now strikes at his messenger
decisions.reason: The rebuke could have led Asa to repent, as he had once responded to the prophet Azariah (15:8). Instead he punishes the seer, the first sign of the change the chapter traces in his last years.

decisions.choice: dealt harshly with (Balanced); treated ... cruelly (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of crushing; Balanced and Readable give its sense (m2).

decisions.choice: the reason before the punishment
decisions.reason: Readable puts Asa's rage first and then what he did, which follows the order of events. It adds "also" to join the two acts of that time.

decisions.choice: "la casa del cepo" (L); "la cárcel, en el cepo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The house of the stocks was a prison where the prisoner was held fast (meaning decision); Spanish "cepo" is the frame for the feet.

decisions.choice: "차꼬를 채우는 집" (L), "감옥에 가두고 차꼬를 채웠다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A prison where the prisoner was held in stocks (m1).

source.text: וְהִנֵּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אָסָ֔א הָרִאשׁוֹנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֤ם כְּתוּבִים֙ עַל־סֵ֣פֶר הַמְּלָכִ֔ים לִיהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, [the] matters of Asa, the first and the last, look, they [are] written on [the] book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

en.L: And look, the matters of Asa, the first and the last, look, they [are] written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
en.B: The acts of Asa, from first to last, are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
en.R: Everything Asa did, from beginning to end, is written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

es.L: Y he aquí, los hechos de Asá, los primeros y los postreros, he aquí [están] escritos en el libro de los reyes de Judá y de Israel.
es.B: Los hechos de Asá, desde el primero hasta el último, están escritos en el libro de los Reyes de Judá y de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo que hizo Asá, desde el principio hasta el fin, está escrito en el libro de los reyes de Judá y de Israel.

fr.L: Et voici, les actes d’Asa, les premiers et les derniers, voici, ils [sont] écrits dans le livre des rois de Juda et d’Israël.
fr.B: Les actes d’Asa, du premier au dernier, sont écrits dans le Livre des rois de Juda et d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout ce qu’Asa a fait, du début à la fin, a été écrit dans le livre des rois de Juda et d’Israël.

sw.L: Na tazama, mambo ya Asa, ya kwanza na ya mwisho, tazama, yameandikwa katika kitabu cha wafalme wa Yuda na Israeli.
sw.B: Mambo ya Asa, tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Wafalme wa Yuda na Israeli.
sw.R: Kila kitu alichofanya Asa, tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho, kimeandikwa katika kitabu cha wafalme wa Yuda na Israeli.

vi.L: Kìa, các việc của A-sa, từ đầu đến cuối, kìa, đã được chép trong sách các vua Giu-đa và Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Các việc của A-sa, từ đầu đến cuối, đều được chép trong Sách Các Vua Giu-đa và Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc A-sa đã làm, từ đầu đến cuối, đều được chép trong sách các vua Giu-đa và Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 아사의 일들은 처음부터 끝까지, 보아라, 유다와 이스라엘 왕들의 책에 기록되어 있다.
ko.B: 아사의 행적은 처음부터 끝까지 유다와 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 아사가 한 모든 일은 처음부터 끝까지 유다와 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

decisions.choice: the sources formula, in Chronicles' form; parallel to 1 Kings 15:23
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 15:23 refers to "the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah" and lists Asa's might and the cities he built. Chronicles names "the book of the kings of Judah and Israel" and speaks of his acts "first and last", that is, his whole reign. Both point the reader to a fuller record that is not part of the Bible.

decisions.choice: look ... look: pointing the reader to the record
decisions.reason: The twice-repeated word draws attention, as if pointing to where the record can be found. It adds emphasis, not a second statement.

decisions.choice: "look" left out
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable carry the pointing word (m2) by the plain statement; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel (Balanced); the book of the kings of Judah and Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced writes the source as a title, as with the other source books in these histories; Readable keeps it plain.

decisions.choice: "el libro de los Reyes de Judá y de Israel" (B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles names its source "the book of the kings of Judah and Israel" (meaning decision); as the terms note asks, the pattern of the source formula is kept, and the name is never "Crónicas".

decisions.choice: "le livre des rois de Juda et d'Israël" (L, R), "le Livre des rois de Juda et d'Israël" (B)
decisions.reason: The source Chronicles names is kept as a description, "rois" in lower case, so that it is not taken for the biblical books of Kings; Balanced writes "Livre" with a capital as the title of a work, as the English Balanced does. Here the Hebrew states it ("look, they are written"), so no level asks a question.

decisions.choice: kitabu cha wafalme wa Yuda na Israeli (Literal, Readable); Kitabu cha Wafalme wa Yuda na Israeli (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Chronicles names its own source "the book of the kings"; Balanced writes it as a title, as the Kings formula does, and it is kept apart from the Swahili title of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "kìa, đã được chép" (L); "Sách Các Vua Giu-đa và Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B), as a title
decisions.reason: Chronicles' own form of the source formula (m1, m2): Literal keeps the pointing "kìa" as 2 Kings 15 does; the book's name follows the Hebrew and is kept apart from the "Sách Lịch Sử" of Kings.

decisions.choice: "유다와 이스라엘 왕들의 책" (L), "유다와 이스라엘 왕 실록" (B), "유다와 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책" (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles' form of the source formula, following the pattern of the terms note; "보아라" kept at Literal only.

source.text: וַיֶּחֱלֶ֣א אָסָ֡א בִּשְׁנַת֩ שְׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים וָתֵ֤שַׁע לְמַלְכוּתוֹ֙ בְּרַגְלָ֔יו עַד־לְמַ֖עְלָה חָלְי֑וֹ וְגַם־בְּחָלְיוֹ֙ לֹא־דָרַ֣שׁ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֖י בָּרֹפְאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And became diseased Asa in [the] year thirty and nine of his reign in his feet, until upward his disease; and also in his disease not he sought Yahweh but the healers.

en.L: And Asa became diseased in the thirty-ninth year of his reign in his feet, until his disease [was] severe; and even in his disease he did not seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but [sought] the physicians.
en.B: Asa's feet became diseased in the thirty-ninth year of his reign, and the disease grew very severe. Even in his sickness he did not seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; he sought only the physicians.
en.R: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa got a disease in his feet. It became very bad. But even when he was so sick, he did not ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help. He went only to the doctors.

es.L: Y enfermó Asá en el año treinta y nueve de su reinado, de los pies, hasta que su enfermedad [fue] muy grave; y aun en su enfermedad no buscó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, sino [buscó] a los médicos.
es.B: En el año treinta y nueve de su reinado Asá enfermó de los pies, y su enfermedad se agravó mucho. Aun en su enfermedad no buscó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, sino que solo buscó a los médicos.
es.R: En el año treinta y nueve de su reinado, Asá tuvo una enfermedad en los pies. Se puso muy grave. Pero aun estando tan enfermo, no le pidió ayuda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Solo fue a ver a los médicos.

fr.L: Et Asa fut malade des pieds en la trente-neuvième année de son règne, jusqu’à ce que sa maladie [fût] très grave ; et même dans sa maladie, il ne rechercha pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais [il rechercha] les médecins.
fr.B: La trente-neuvième année de son règne, Asa eut une maladie des pieds, et le mal devint très grave. Même dans sa maladie, il ne rechercha pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; il ne rechercha que les médecins.
fr.R: Pendant la trente-neuvième année de son règne, Asa a eu une maladie des pieds. Elle est devenue très grave. Mais même quand il était si malade, il n’a pas demandé d’aide {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il est allé seulement voir les médecins.

sw.L: Asa akaugua miguu yake katika mwaka wa thelathini na tisa wa kutawala kwake, hata ugonjwa wake [ukawa] mkali sana; lakini hata katika ugonjwa wake hakumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, bali [aliwatafuta] waganga.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na tisa wa utawala wake, Asa aliugua miguu, na ugonjwa wake ukawa mkali sana. Hata katika ugonjwa wake hakumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; aliwatafuta waganga tu.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na tisa wa utawala wake, Asa alipata ugonjwa wa miguu. Ukawa mbaya sana. Lakini hata alipokuwa mgonjwa hivyo, hakumwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} msaada. Alikwenda kwa waganga tu.

vi.L: Năm thứ ba mươi chín triều đại mình, A-sa mắc bệnh ở chân, cho đến khi bệnh [trở nên] rất nặng; nhưng ngay cả trong cơn bệnh, ông không tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mà [tìm đến] các thầy thuốc.
vi.B: Năm thứ ba mươi chín triều đại mình, A-sa mắc bệnh ở chân, và bệnh trở nên rất nặng. Ngay cả trong cơn bệnh vua cũng không tìm cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mà chỉ tìm đến các thầy thuốc.
vi.R: Năm thứ ba mươi chín A-sa làm vua, vua mắc bệnh ở chân. Bệnh trở nên rất nặng. Nhưng ngay cả khi bệnh nặng như vậy, vua cũng không cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ. Vua chỉ tìm đến các thầy thuốc.

ko.L: 그리고 아사가 그의 통치 제39년에 발에 병이 들었는데, 그의 병이 매우 심해졌다. 그러나 그의 병중에도 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾지 않고 의사들을 [찾았다].
ko.B: 아사는 다스린 지 39년째 되는 해에 발에 병이 들었고, 그 병은 매우 심해졌다. 그러나 그는 병들어서도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾지 않고 의사들만 찾았다.
ko.R: 아사가 왕이 된 지 39년째 되는 해에 그의 발에 병이 생겼다. 그 병은 아주 심해졌다. 그러나 그렇게 아플 때에도 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 하지 않았다. 그는 의사들만 찾아갔다.

decisions.choice: diseased in his feet: as in 1 Kings 15:23, with a date and a judgment added
decisions.reason: Kings says only that in his old age Asa was diseased in his feet; on whether "feet" is meant plainly, see the note there. Chronicles dates the illness to his thirty-ninth year, two years before his death, and adds that it became severe and that he did not seek the LORD in it.

decisions.choice: until upward: until it was very severe
decisions.reason: The phrase means "to a high degree". It may also mean that the disease spread upward from his feet, but the common use of the phrase points to its severity.

decisions.choice: he did not seek the LORD, but the physicians: the fault is turning from God, not using healers
alternatives: any use of physicians was wrong
decisions.reason: To seek the LORD is the key mark of a faithful king in Chronicles; Asa had once led Judah to seek him (14:3; 15:12-15). Here he seeks help from the physicians and not from the LORD, the same fault as relying on Aram (verse 7). The text does not condemn healers as such; it condemns seeking them in place of God.

decisions.choice: [sought]
decisions.reason: Literal brackets the verb that the Hebrew carries over from the clause before.

decisions.choice: only
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "only" to bring out the contrast "not the LORD, but the physicians" (m3).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אָסָ֖א עִם־אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיָּ֕מָת בִּשְׁנַ֛ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְאַחַ֖ת לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Asa with his fathers, and he died in [the] year forty and one of his reigning.

en.L: And Asa lay down with his fathers, and he died in the forty-first year of his reign.
en.B: Then Asa rested with his ancestors; he died in the forty-first year of his reign.
en.R: Then Asa died, in the forty-first year of his reign.

es.L: Y durmió Asá con sus padres, y murió en el año cuarenta y uno de su reinado.
es.B: Luego Asá descansó con sus antepasados; murió en el año cuarenta y uno de su reinado.
es.R: Luego Asá murió, en el año cuarenta y uno de su reinado.

fr.L: Et Asa se coucha avec ses pères, et il mourut en la quarante et unième année de son règne.
fr.B: Puis Asa reposa avec ses ancêtres ; il mourut la quarante et unième année de son règne.
fr.R: Ensuite Asa est mort, pendant la quarante et unième année de son règne.

sw.L: Asa akalala pamoja na baba zake, akafa katika mwaka wa arobaini na mmoja wa kutawala kwake.
sw.B: Kisha Asa akapumzika pamoja na babu zake; alikufa katika mwaka wa arobaini na mmoja wa utawala wake.
sw.R: Kisha Asa akafa, katika mwaka wa arobaini na mmoja wa utawala wake.

vi.L: A-sa nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và ông qua đời vào năm thứ bốn mươi mốt triều đại mình.
vi.B: Rồi A-sa an giấc cùng tổ tiên; vua qua đời vào năm thứ bốn mươi mốt triều đại mình.
vi.R: Rồi A-sa qua đời vào năm thứ bốn mươi mốt triều đại mình.

ko.L: 그리고 아사가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 그의 통치 제41년에 죽었다.
ko.B: 아사는 조상들과 함께 잠들었다. 그는 다스린 지 41년째 되는 해에 죽었다.
ko.R: 아사는 왕이 된 지 41년째 되는 해에 죽었다.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula, as in 1 Kings 15:24, where it is also followed by the burial. Here the plain verb "died" follows it.

decisions.choice: the forty-first year: the length of reign given in 1 Kings 15:10
decisions.reason: Kings says Asa reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. Chronicles dates his death to the forty-first year of his reign and leaves out the note in 1 Kings 15:24 that he was buried with his fathers, describing his own tomb instead (verse 14).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula of these books. Readable says "died" once for both verbs.

source.text: וַיִּקְבְּרֻ֣הוּ בְקִבְרֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּֽרָה־לוֹ֮ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִיד֒ וַיַּשְׁכִּיבֻ֗הוּ בַּמִּשְׁכָּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּא֙ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים וּזְנִ֔ים מְרֻקָּחִ֖ים בְּמִרְקַ֣חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ־ל֥וֹ שְׂרֵפָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה עַד־לִמְאֹֽד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they buried him in his tombs which he had cut for himself in [the] city of David, and they laid him on [the] bier which was filled [with] spices and kinds mixed by [the] mixing of [a] perfumer's work; and they burned for him a burning great to very.

en.L: And they buried him in his own tombs that he had cut for himself in the City of David, and they laid him on the bier that was filled [with] spices and kinds [of perfumes] mixed by the perfumer's art; and they made for him a very great burning.
en.B: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had hewn for himself in the City of David, and laid him on a bier filled with spices and many kinds of perfumes blended by the perfumer's art. And they made a very great fire in his honor.
en.R: They buried him in the tomb he had dug out for himself in the City of David. They laid his body on a bed covered with spices and all kinds of sweet-smelling oils, mixed by skilled perfume makers. Then they burned a very large fire to honor him.

es.L: Y lo sepultaron en sus sepulcros que él se había cavado en la ciudad de David, y lo pusieron en el lecho que estaba lleno de especias y de [perfumes] de diversas clases, mezclados según el arte del perfumista; e hicieron por él una hoguera muy grande.
es.B: Lo sepultaron en su propio sepulcro, que él mismo se había cavado en la ciudad de David, y lo pusieron sobre un lecho lleno de especias y de toda clase de perfumes preparados según el arte del perfumista. E hicieron una hoguera muy grande en su honor.
es.R: Lo sepultaron en el sepulcro que se había hecho cavar en la ciudad de David. Pusieron su cuerpo sobre una cama cubierta de especias y de toda clase de aceites perfumados, mezclados por hábiles perfumistas. Después encendieron una hoguera muy grande para honrarlo.

fr.L: Et on l’enterra dans ses tombeaux qu’il s’était creusés dans la cité de David, et on le coucha sur le lit qu’on avait rempli d’aromates et de sortes [de parfums] mélangés selon l’art du parfumeur ; et on fit pour lui un très grand feu.
fr.B: On l’enterra dans le tombeau qu’il s’était fait creuser dans la cité de David, et on le coucha sur un lit rempli d’aromates et de toutes sortes de parfums préparés selon l’art du parfumeur. Et on fit en son honneur un très grand feu.
fr.R: On l’a enterré dans le tombeau qu’il s’était fait creuser dans la cité de David. On a couché son corps sur un lit couvert d’aromates et de toutes sortes d’huiles parfumées, mélangées par d’habiles parfumeurs. Puis on a allumé un très grand feu pour l’honorer.

sw.L: Wakamzika katika makaburi yake mwenyewe aliyojichongea katika mji wa Daudi, wakamlaza juu ya jeneza lililojazwa manukato na aina [za marashi] zilizochanganywa kwa ustadi wa mtengeneza marashi; wakamfanyia moto mkubwa mno.
sw.B: Walimzika katika kaburi lake mwenyewe alilokuwa amejichongea katika mji wa Daudi, wakamlaza juu ya jeneza lililojaa manukato na aina nyingi za marashi zilizochanganywa kwa ustadi wa mtengeneza marashi. Wakawasha moto mkubwa sana kwa heshima yake.
sw.R: Walimzika katika kaburi alilokuwa amejichimbia katika mji wa Daudi. Wakamlaza juu ya kitanda kilichofunikwa kwa manukato na kila aina ya mafuta yenye harufu nzuri, yaliyochanganywa na mafundi stadi wa marashi. Kisha wakawasha moto mkubwa sana kwa heshima yake.

vi.L: Người ta chôn ông trong các huyệt mà ông đã đục cho mình trong thành Đa-vít, và đặt ông trên một chiếc giường đầy hương liệu và [các loại dầu thơm] được pha chế theo nghề thợ chế hương; và họ đốt cho ông một đám lửa rất lớn.
vi.B: Người ta chôn vua trong ngôi mộ vua đã đục sẵn cho mình trong thành Đa-vít, đặt vua trên một chiếc giường đầy hương liệu và đủ loại dầu thơm được pha chế theo nghề chế hương. Rồi họ đốt một đám lửa rất lớn để tôn vinh vua.
vi.R: Người ta chôn vua trong ngôi mộ vua đã đục sẵn cho mình trong thành Đa-vít. Họ đặt thi hài vua trên một chiếc giường phủ đầy hương liệu và đủ loại dầu thơm do những người thợ chế hương lành nghề pha chế. Rồi họ đốt một đám lửa thật lớn để tôn vinh vua.

ko.L: 그리고 사람들이 그를 그가 다윗 성에 자기를 위하여 판 그의 무덤들에 묻었다. 그리고 그들이 향료사의 기술로 섞은 향료와 [향품들을] 가득 채운 침상에 그를 눕히고, 그를 위하여 매우 큰 불을 피웠다.
ko.B: 사람들은 그가 다윗 성에 자기를 위하여 파 둔 무덤에 그를 묻었다. 그들은 향료사의 솜씨로 섞은 여러 가지 향료와 향품을 가득 채운 상여에 그를 눕히고, 그를 기리어 매우 큰 불을 피웠다.
ko.R: 사람들은 그를 그가 다윗 성에 파 두었던 무덤에 묻었다. 그들은 솜씨 좋은 향료사들이 섞어 만든 향료와 향기로운 기름을 깐 침상에 그의 몸을 눕혔다. 그리고 그를 기리려고 아주 큰 불을 피웠다.

decisions.choice: his tombs that he had cut for himself: a family tomb cut into the rock
decisions.reason: The plural "tombs" suggests a rock-cut tomb with several burial places. Asa had it cut for himself in the City of David, where the kings of Judah were buried (compare 1 Kings 15:24, "with his fathers").

decisions.choice: which was filled: filled by others, or filled at Asa's own order
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. It may be impersonal, "which had been filled", or mean that Asa had it filled beforehand, as he had cut his tomb.

decisions.choice: spices and kinds mixed by the perfumer's art: fragrant spices and blended ointments laid with the body
decisions.reason: Spices and perfumed ointments were laid with the dead to honor them and to mask the smell of death (compare John 19:39-40). "Kinds" means many kinds of these preparations, mixed by a trained perfumer.

decisions.choice: a very great burning: a fire made in the king's honor, not a cremation
decisions.reason: The body was buried, not burned. The fire was a mark of honor at a king's funeral, probably the burning of spices; Jeremiah 34:5 speaks of such burnings for the kings of Judah, and 21:19 says the people made no fire for Jehoram, as they had for his fathers.

decisions.choice: the tomb (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "tomb" for the plural, since it was one tomb with several places (m1).

decisions.choice: [of perfumes], perfumes, oils; in his honor, to honor him
decisions.reason: English names what the "kinds" were (m3), and Balanced and Readable say what the fire was for (m4).

decisions.choice: "una hoguera muy grande"
decisions.reason: The fire was made in the king's honor, not a cremation (meaning decision); Spanish "hoguera" names the fire and Balanced and Readable say it was for his honor.

decisions.choice: "để tôn vinh vua" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A fire in the king's honor, not a cremation (m4); Balanced and Readable say so, as the English.

decisions.choice: "매우 큰 불을 피웠다", with "그를 기리어" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A fire made in the king's honor, not a cremation (m4).
